title: Seven years of operating budgets and actual spending
question: How much did Caltrain spend against each year’s budget, and how much did passengers pay?
finding: FY2025 operating expenses were $225.254 million against $247.628 million budgeted. Passenger fares covered 26.1% of reported expenses, compared with 69.7% in FY2019. FY2021 was over budget, including $22.278 million in contract services and $8.920 million in professional services above budget.
how: Compare each year’s supplementary budgetary-basis schedule. A positive expense variance means spending below budget. The table retains each report’s published variance, including small differences from its displayed rounded inputs.
limits: Nominal dollars. The calculated fare share uses passenger fares alone. Financing, sales taxes, and capital outlays sit outside this comparison. Timing, inflation, pandemic demand and the change in train service affect comparisons across years.
